description_en: Calls the ModifySecurityIps operation to modify the whitelist of an instance
description_zh: 调用ModifySecurityIps接口修改实例白名单
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx modify-security-ips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-hzjasd0000 --security-ip-list 127.0.0.1,192.168.0.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityIps

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the whitelist group of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例的白名单分组名称
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en: The list of IP addresses in the whitelist group. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 白名单分组里的IP列表，多个IP白名单间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The modification mode of the whitelist. Valid values:

0: overwrites the whitelist group.
1: adds a whitelist group.
2: deletes a whitelist group
parameters.help_zh:
白名单修改模式，取值范围如下：

0：覆盖修改白名单分组；
1：新增白名单分组；
2：删除白名单分组
parameters.name: modify_mode

Message.description_en: The response message. "success" is returned if the request is successful. Otherwise, an error code is returned
Message.description_zh: 请求返回信息，正确显示success，错误显示错误码

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
